name: av_lin_two_in_two_out
source:
{ A 2-state, 2-input, 2-output linearization — every matrix is genuinely 2x2,
  so a transposition or column-ordering difference is visible. }
Q_in = 1000
Tamb = 300
HeatSource    HS(Q = Q_in)
ThermalMass   M1(C = 5000, T0 = 300)
Conduction    w12(k = 2, area = 1, L = 0.1)
ThermalMass   M2(C = 8000, T0 = 310)
Conduction    w2a(k = 1.5, area = 1, L = 0.2)
ThermalSource amb(T = Tamb)
connect(HS.port, M1.port, w12.a)
connect(w12.b, M2.port, w2a.a)
connect(w2a.b, amb.port)
DYNAMIC warmup(time = 0 .. 1)
END
LINEARIZE plant(block = warmup, a = Am, b = Bm, c = Cm, d = Dm)
  INPUT  Q_in, Tamb
  OUTPUT m1.port.T, m2.port.T
END
